module.label: Lobby screens
module.description: Spirit Afterparty screens, eighteen surprises and organic autonomous choreography.

steps.label: Copy a bounded upload and verify its format
steps.detail: Up to 80 MB; finite reads and cancellation use the existing HTTP request lifetime.

steps.label: Snapshot history and publish the complete catalog atomically
Preserve originals and remove incomplete copies
Validate each screen choice and message
Snapshot and merge into the latest catalog
steps.detail: Unknown fields and malformed personal entries are preserved; invalid files are not reset.

steps.label: Active browser displays refresh the saved selection
steps.detail: The existing document loop owns bounded catalog refresh and four media slots; hidden documents pause media, abort refresh and release animation. No program-scene or audio changes.

trigger.label: Wake up the room button or Interact key

steps.label: Validate a named action and unique cue identity
steps.detail: The stateless feature catalog owns labels, keys, drawing stages and finite lifetimes.

steps.label: Relay the cue through existing Hub browser transport
steps.detail: No OBS writes, new bus or global worker. Visible documents own one SSE stream; hide and teardown close it.

steps.label: Add an independent accent without replacing accepted work
steps.detail: Deduplicate local/server echoes and discard delivery older than four seconds. Limit 24 instances and 1,600 drawing units; decline excess new work. Repeated waves queue and alternate hands.

steps.label: Expire accents and release document-owned resources
steps.detail: One existing frame loop draws effects; foreground clips the camera opening. Teardown empties instances and cancels bounded HTTP requests.

trigger.label: Open a visible lobby with automatic party enabled

steps.label: Join varied shared-clock party phrases
steps.detail: The canonical action catalog supplies finite lifetime, novelty weight and visual impact. Gentle/lively/wild rhythm and Motion scale gaps; phrases never form a repeating playlist.

steps.label: Mix surprises using soft visual pressure and recent variety
steps.detail: Favor lighter accents during busy moments, sometimes add a companion, and suppress some new arrivals around manual bursts. No required visible count; original lights and penguins keep moving.

steps.label: Admit independent accents in the existing frame loop
steps.detail: Both OBS layers compute matching identities, seeds and ages locally. New ambient work cannot reset a manual animation. Camera opening stays clear.

steps.label: Release work when hidden or closed
steps.detail: No new global timer, worker or broadcast. Hidden/paused documents do not schedule; resume joins the current party without backlog. Cache at most four phrases and 256 attempt IDs; teardown clears both.
